scheme_name: Free Caste Hostel (De-Notified, Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic Communities)
other_conditions: Applicant must be a student belonging to the De-Notified, Nomadic, or Semi-Nomadic tribes
Applicant must be studying in a local educational institution
Applicant must apply for admission before the new academic session
Applicant must secure a vacant seat as new admissions depend on availability
Applicant must have a higher percentage in the last passed examination for priority admission
benefits_summary: Scholarship of ₹1,230 per month for boys and ₹1,270 per month for girls, payable for 10 months.
